verdict.rationale: LocalAI's docs describe a dedicated MCP feature: agents (e.g. local-ai chat) can attach to one or more MCP servers via metadata.mcp_servers, giving them tool-use/agentic capability, and this is documented as a first-class, named feature (not third-party workaround). missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that MCP server connections work in practice, and clearer detail on whether LocalAI itself can also be addressed as an MCP server by other agents.
